filmBrief.logline: Three neighbors build three very different homes, and discover what holds up when a boastful wolf comes calling.
filmBrief.notes: 76 editable visual beats. Usually one or two spoken sentences per beat. Whole-character three-quarter felt pose swaps; no face-only turns or stretched limbs. Camera holds let the repeated refrains and jokes land. Fable narration is saved in each scene. Present offers manual read-aloud pages; Play movie and MP4 use the full voiced timeline. Pigs stay safe; the wolf lands in cold water. Story and artwork created for Drew’s private Felt & Fable studio.
